import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=np.array(G['Test input']); O=None
H,W=I.shape
# mask of known cells (not 8)
mask=(I!=8)
# find best translations via correlation over known cells only
best=[]
for dr in range(-H+1,H):
    for dc in range(-W+1,W):
        s=((np.array([[mask[i][j] and mask[i+dr][j+dc]] for i in range(H)]) if False else None))
        S=np.array([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if mask[i][j] and mask[i+dr][j+dc]])
        if len(S)<2000: continue
        match=sum(I[i][j]==I[i+dr][j+dc] for i,j in S)/len(S)
        best.append((match,dr,dc,len(S)))
best.sort(reverse=True)
print(best[:8])
